title: Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles of categories M, N and O with regard to braking

paragraphs.title: Scope
paragraphs.text: This Regulation applies to vehicles of categories M2, M3, N and O with regard to braking.

paragraphs.title: Vehicles of categories M2 and M3
paragraphs.text: In the case of vehicles of categories M2 and M3, the braking requirements set out in Annex 4 shall apply.

paragraphs.title: Definitions
paragraphs.text: For the purposes of this Regulation, the following definitions shall apply:

paragraphs.title: Braking system
paragraphs.text: "Braking system" means the combination of parts whose function is to progressively reduce the speed of a moving vehicle, bring it to a halt, or keep it stationary if it is already halted; these functions are specified in paragraph 5.1. The system comprises the control, the transmission and the brake(s) proper.

paragraphs.title: Service braking system
paragraphs.text: "Service braking system" means the braking system which allows the driver to control the movement of the vehicle and bring it to a halt safely, quickly and effectively, whatever its conditions of loading, and whatever the upward or downward gradient on which it is standing.

paragraphs.title: Secondary braking system
paragraphs.text: "Secondary braking system" means the braking system which allows the driver to halt the vehicle in the event of failure of the service braking system. It does not exclude the use of a control shared with that of the service braking system.

paragraphs.title: Parking braking system
paragraphs.text: "Parking braking system" means the braking system which allows the vehicle to be held stationary on an inclined surface even in the absence of the driver, the active parts being then held in the locked position by a purely mechanical device.

paragraphs.title: General requirements
paragraphs.text: Every vehicle shall be equipped with a braking system which shall comply with the requirements set out in Annex 4.

paragraphs.title: Functions of braking systems
paragraphs.text: The braking system of every vehicle shall fulfil the following functions: (a) service braking, enabling the movement of the vehicle to be controlled and the vehicle to be brought to a halt safely, quickly and effectively; (b) secondary braking, enabling the vehicle to be brought to a halt in the event of failure of the service braking system, though at a reduced efficiency; (c) parking braking, enabling the vehicle to be held stationary on an upward or downward gradient, in the absence of the driver, the active parts being then held in the locked position by a purely mechanical device.

paragraphs.title: Braking systems on vehicles of category N
paragraphs.text: The braking systems prescribed in paragraph 5.1 shall be so designed that they act on braking surfaces permanently connected to the wheels through components of adequate strength.
